data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: missing_error_path): Add 5 more edge case tests to test_cycle_dispatcher.py: (a) ledger file does not exist (first-ever cycle on fresh worktree) → DISPATCH_NEXT cycle=1, no crash; (b) ledger JSON corrupt → deterministic action (DISPATCH_NEXT cycle=1 with recovery reason); (c) schema_version > 1.1.0 → log warning, best-effort proceed, no raise (forward-compat per cycle-ledger.md Evolution Rules); (d) reconstruction_gaps=True with cycles len >= 2 — pick one interpretation (skip Jaccard) and test it explicitly; (e) ledger has cycle entry with commit_sha != current AND cycle_num == max_cycles — define SHA-change-reset-vs-max-cycles-arbiter ordering and test it.
